# buildrun

```go
import "github.com/blanketops/environments-controller/pkg/controller/observers/buildrun"
```

Package buildrun re\-exports the buildrun\-observer reconciler type as a public alias. The reconciler itself stays in internal/controller/observers/buildrun, unchanged; this package exists only so that external test modules have a valid, non\-internal import path to construct it against.

<a name="Reconciler"></a>
## type Reconciler

Reconciler observes Shipwright BuildRun objects and reflects their terminal Succeeded condition back onto the owning Build CR's status.

```go
type Reconciler = internalbuildrun.Reconciler
```
